privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: What Kanaku collects, why we collect it, who can see it and the choices you have. We keep it short and we don't sell your data.

sections.title: About this policy
blocks: Kanaku is a personal-finance web app that helps you record income and expenses, set budgets and see where your money goes. This policy explains how Kanaku (“we”, “us”) handles your personal information when you use the website and its services.
By creating an account you confirm that you have read this policy and agree to it. If you don't agree, please don't use Kanaku.

sections.title: Information we collect
blocks: We only collect what we need to run your account.
Account details: your name, e-mail address and password. Your password is never stored as typed; only a salted one-way hash is kept.
Security details: the secret behind your authenticator app (stored encrypted), the last code you used, and failed-attempt counters used to stop guessing.
Setup answers: your currency, optional monthly income, salary day, savings goal and the spending categories you chose during onboarding.
Money you record: transactions (description, amount, date, category, payment method, note and whether it repeats), the edit history of each transaction, and your budgets.
Temporary codes: the one-time codes we e-mail you to verify your address or reset your password. They are stored hashed and deleted automatically once they expire (15 minutes).
Technical data: our hosting and database providers may keep standard server logs, such as IP address and request time, to keep the service running and secure.
Kanaku does not connect to your bank accounts, cards or UPI apps, and we do not currently store receipt files. Everything in your account is information you enter yourself.

sections.title: How we use your information
blocks: To create and secure your account, including e-mail verification and two-step sign-in.
To show your transactions, budgets, dashboard figures and exports.
To send service e-mails such as verification and password-reset codes. We do not send marketing e-mail.
To protect against fraud, abuse and security incidents, and to fix bugs.
To meet legal obligations.
We do not sell your personal information, we do not show advertising, and we do not use your financial data to build advertising profiles.

sections.title: Your consent and legal basis
blocks: We process your information with your consent, which you give when you create an account and accept this policy, and where it is necessary to provide the service you asked for. You can withdraw consent at any time by deleting your account (see section 9); withdrawing consent means we can no longer provide the service.
We handle personal data in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. If you live in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we apply comparable protections for you.

sections.title: Who we share it with
blocks: We share information only with service providers that help us run Kanaku, and only what they need:
Database hosting: MongoDB Atlas stores your account and financial data.
E-mail delivery: an SMTP e-mail provider delivers verification and password-reset messages. It sees your address and the message content.
Web hosting: the provider that serves the website and API.

We may disclose information if the law requires it, or to protect the rights, safety and security of our users or the service. If Kanaku is ever merged with or acquired by another organisation, your information may transfer to it and this policy will continue to apply until you are told otherwise.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
blocks: Kanaku uses only the cookies and browser storage it needs to work. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
kanaku_session (cookie): keeps you signed in. It is HTTP-only and lasts for the browser session, one day or 30 days if you choose “remember me”.
kanaku_flow (cookie): remembers which step of sign-up, verification or password reset you are on. It lasts up to an hour.
kanaku-theme and kanaku-sidebar-collapsed (local storage): remember your light/dark choice and whether the sidebar is collapsed. They stay on your device.
Because these are essential, blocking them will stop sign-in from working.

sections.title: How we protect your data
blocks: Passwords are hashed with scrypt and a unique salt.
Two-step sign-in with an authenticator app is required for every account, and authenticator secrets are encrypted at rest.
Connections to Kanaku are encrypted in transit.
Every request is checked against your session, and you can only reach your own data.
No online service is perfectly secure. Please use a strong, unique password, keep your authenticator device safe and tell us straight away if you think someone else has access to your account.

sections.title: How long we keep it
blocks: We keep your account and financial data for as long as your account is open. Verification and reset codes are deleted automatically when they expire. When you delete your account we delete your personal data from our database, except anything we must keep to meet a legal obligation. Routine backups and provider logs are overwritten on their normal schedule.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
blocks: You can ask us at any time to:
give you a copy of the personal data we hold about you (you can also export your transactions as a CSV file from the Transactions page);
correct information that is wrong or incomplete;
delete your account and the data in it;
withdraw your consent, or object to a particular use of your data;
nominate someone to exercise these rights on your behalf if you are unable to, as allowed under Indian law.

Contact us using the details in section 12. We may need to confirm it's really you before we act, and we aim to reply within 30 days. If you are not happy with our answer you can complain to us first, and then to the Data Protection Board of India or your local data-protection authority.

sections.title: Children
blocks: Kanaku is meant for people aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: Where your data is stored, and changes
blocks: Our providers may store and process data in data centres outside your country, including outside India. Wherever it is handled, we require providers to protect it to a standard consistent with this policy.
We may update this policy as Kanaku changes. When we make a significant change we will tell you by e-mail or in the app before it takes effect. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.

sections.title: Contact and grievances
blocks: Questions, requests or complaints about your privacy can be sent to our support team. Use the contact details below and write “Privacy” in the subject. Our grievance contact will acknowledge your message and respond within the time set by law.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: The rules for using Kanaku. In short: it's a tool for tracking your own money, it isn't financial advice, and you're responsible for keeping your account secure.

sections.title: Agreement to these terms
blocks: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) are an agreement between you and Kanaku (“we”, “us”) about your use of the Kanaku website and services (the “Service”). By creating an account or using the Service you accept these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you don't accept them, don't use the Service.

sections.title: What Kanaku is, and isn't
blocks: Kanaku helps you record your income and spending, set budgets and view summaries of your own finances.
Kanaku is not a bank, lender, payment service or investment adviser. We never hold, move or invest your money.

Nothing in the Service is financial, tax, investment or legal advice. Figures, percentages and suggestions (such as suggested budgets or “safe to spend” amounts) are generated from what you enter, are for information only, and you decide what to do with them.

sections.title: Who can use Kanaku
blocks: You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter into a binding contract. By using the Service you confirm that you meet these requirements.

sections.title: Your account
blocks: Give accurate information when you sign up and keep it up to date.
You must verify your e-mail address and set up an authenticator app. You can't use the Service without two-step sign-in.
Keep your password and authenticator device private. You are responsible for activity under your account unless you tell us promptly that it has been compromised.
One person, one account. Don't share an account or create accounts for someone else without their permission.

sections.title: Your data
blocks: You own the information you put into Kanaku, such as your transactions, notes and budgets. You give us permission to store, process and display it solely to operate and improve the Service for you, as described in our Privacy Policy.
You are responsible for the accuracy of what you enter. Kanaku can only be as accurate as your records.

sections.title: Acceptable use
blocks: Please don't:
break the law or use the Service for fraud, money laundering or any unlawful purpose;
try to access another person's account or data, or probe, scan or test the Service's security without our written permission;
overload or disrupt the Service, or use bots, scrapers or automated means to access it in ways we haven't allowed;
upload malicious code, or reverse engineer, copy or resell the Service;
put someone else's personal information into the Service without their permission.
We may suspend or limit an account that breaks these rules or puts the Service or other users at risk.

sections.title: Our rights in the Service
blocks: The Kanaku name, logo, design, software and content (other than your data) belong to us or our licensors. We give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable right to use the Service for your own personal finances while these Terms apply. We reserve all other rights.

sections.title: Price
blocks: Kanaku is currently provided free of charge. If we introduce paid features we will tell you first and will not charge you unless you choose to subscribe.

sections.title: Availability and changes
blocks: We work to keep Kanaku available and your data safe, but we don't promise the Service will always be uninterrupted or error-free. We may add, change or remove features, and may carry out maintenance, with or without notice. Because we cannot guarantee against data loss, keep your own records of anything important; you can export your transactions as CSV from the Transactions page.

sections.title: Ending your account
blocks: You can stop using Kanaku at any time and ask us to delete your account using the contact details below. We may suspend or end your access if you seriously or repeatedly break these Terms, if the law requires it, or if we stop offering the Service; where reasonable we will give you notice and a chance to export your data first. Sections that by their nature should survive (such as 11, 12 and 14) continue after your account ends.

sections.title: Disclaimers
blocks: To the fullest extent the law allows, the Service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy and non-infringement. We do not warrant that figures or projections shown are complete, accurate or suitable for your decisions.

sections.title: Limit of liability
blocks: To the fullest extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses, or for loss of profits, savings, data or goodwill, arising from your use of the Service. Our total liability for any claim relating to the Service is limited to the amount you paid us for it in the 12 months before the claim, or ₹1,000 if you paid nothing.
Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or any rights you have under consumer-protection law.

sections.title: Changes to these Terms
blocks: We may update these Terms from time to time. For significant changes we will notify you by e-mail or in the app before they take effect. If you keep using the Service after the change takes effect, you accept the updated Terms. If you don't agree, stop using the Service and delete your account.

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
blocks: These Terms are governed by the laws of India. We encourage you to contact us first so we can try to resolve any dispute informally. If we can't, the courts of India will have jurisdiction, subject to any mandatory rights you have under the law of the place where you live.

sections.title: Contact
blocks: Questions about these Terms, or requests to delete your account, can be sent to our support team using the details below.
